limitations: No Maestri Portal was connected; authorized local controllable Playwright was used.

out_of_scope: External PostHog provider behavior beyond the consent boundary

journeys.name: Activate privacy-safe analytics only after applicable consent
evidence: Zero analytics requests occurred before consent.
Zero analytics requests occurred after essential-only selection and tagged CTA interaction.
Analytics initialized and cta_clicked emitted only after explicit analytics consent in a clean context.
Analytics property keys were checked against lead and PII fields without printing request bodies or values.

journeys.name: Resolve a real campaign entry through the local API
evidence: No matching API route or campaign-link persistence model exists in apps/api/src or apps/api/drizzle.
The real browser observed non-2xx responses and rendered the unavailable-link fallback instead of resolving a destination.

journeys.name: Start the real stack from an empty PostgreSQL database
evidence: The constraint is created in both apps/api/drizzle/0004_aberrant_puppet_master.sql:127 and apps/api/drizzle/0021_flawless_raider.sql:14.

screenshots.checkpoint: Essential-only choice applied with no analytics traffic
observations: Consent banner is absent and the landing page remains unobstructed; network recorder remained empty.
Capture occurred during the consent banner exit transition; wait condition was corrected, but clean recapture is pending the final-SHA rerun.

screenshots.checkpoint: Unavailable campaign fallback after missing API contract
observations: Fallback is readable and fits mobile, but it confirms the missing campaign happy path rather than satisfying it.

access_checks.vector: Analytics initialization and tagged CTA events across consent states
access_checks.evidence: Analytics remained inactive before consent and for essential-only; recorded post-consent property keys excluded lead and PII fields.

findings.title: Campaign entry has no integrated resolve endpoint
evidence: Site requests GET /campaign-links/:slug/resolve, but no matching API route or persistence model exists.
Real browser runs observed 404 and 500 responses and only the unavailable-link fallback.

findings.title: Empty PostgreSQL migration chain creates a duplicate FK
evidence: Migration failed with PostgreSQL 42710 before browser startup.

findings.title: Post-consent screenshot captured the banner exit transition
evidence: The scaffold now waits until the consent button is not visible; recapture awaits the authorized final-SHA rerun.

findings.title: Abrupt webServer termination left suite-owned PostgreSQL processes
evidence: Only validated suite-prefixed processes were stopped; Playwright now grants the API helper a 10-second graceful SIGTERM window.
